scope: One connected mountain workshop chapter: shared ballast, crew latch, high archive, linked forward/reverse gears, freight pilot and pumps, cargo hoist and two-gate counterbalance vault. Overview camera remains.

packed_physical_checks.method: Staged physical dependency and failure fixtures for 2/3/4 explorers; not a full traversal.

packed_mixed_party.method: Full ordinary input/action RPC journey: two independent human-owned clients and two normal bots. Automated client drivers, not first-time human players.

verification_limits: 30–45 minutes is a first-time human playtest target, not a measured result.
Known-solution all-bot execution completes in about 131 seconds; it does not measure human reasoning time or enjoyment.
Android is development-signed; emulator install/start is checked. Physical-phone performance, LAN broadcast and human touch accuracy remain unverified.
P2 world-label/overlay crowding remains in some later views; bounded consumer reviews do not certify the entire experience.
Public multiplayer uses a temporary tunnel while the host Mac stays online.
